policy.gap_definition: A CEW-13 gap is missing ordinary ecological representation for a materially distinguishing governed ENV condition, not proof that a canonical creature population is absent.

gap_status_vocabulary.cew13_gap_expansion_authored: ordinary environment-specific ecological coverage gap repaired with governed noncanonical profiles
gap_status_vocabulary.cew12_baseline_reuse_sufficient: CEW-12 abstraction is sufficient; no new CEW-13 profile
gap_status_vocabulary.deferred_nonordinary_cew14: multiversal/alien/nonordinary wildlife expansion deferred to CEW-14
gap_status_vocabulary.distribution_dependent_no_auto_expansion: built/contextual environment cannot create presence without independent distribution/local-placement authority
